selection.dataset_rule: top two descending sums of v2 H2GCN measured_seconds_per_epoch over both conditions and all four trials; dataset name ascending breaks ties
selection.trial_rule: within each selected dataset take the original trial with largest summed v2 measured_seconds_per_epoch over both conditions; original trial_id ascending breaks ties
selection.ranking_limit: ranking uses the existing three-step v2 probe only; Actor and third-ranked Coauthor-CS are close, so it does not identify a general worst-case ordering or a causal adjacency bottleneck
selection.scope_note: timing fixtures only; does not reduce the formal eleven-dataset, two-condition, seven-model, ten-seed, four-trial scope

worker_order.first_repeat: nested dataset order, condition order, cpu_thread_order, checkpoint_mode order

execution.cuda_startup_guard: set CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1 before importing Torch in each fresh interpreter; reject visible GPUs or initialized CUDA before measurement and after the probe
execution.architecture: unchanged original H2GCNModel and original CPU sparse COO adjacencies

training.checkpoint_schedule: one snapshot after every optimization step; replace slot step modulo four; no score-based checkpoint selection
training.full_state_copy: clone every original model state_dict tensor for each snapshot
training.static_adjacency_once: clone the two immutable adjacency buffers once per worker and share read-only references; independently clone all remaining state tensors for each snapshot
training.restore_semantics: reconstruct the complete original state_dict from each slot; optimizer state is audited but is not added to the original model-checkpoint definition

timing.step_total: end-to-end wall time including identical per-step audit/recording tasks in both modes; separately report compute-only subtotal and each component
timing.no_double_counting: report parent and nested timings separately; sum only nonoverlapping parent components when reconciling end-to-end step and worker time
timing.worker_reconciliation: report coordinator-observed whole-worker wall, accounted nonoverlapping setup/step/post-trajectory time, unattributed worker residual, final record write, and launch/import/completion/coordinator residual separately
timing.steady_summary: median of steps 3 through 9 within each worker; use the slower of two independent repeat medians for every dataset-condition-thread-mode fixture
timing.cold_and_warmup: report step 0 and steps 1-2 separately; never discard or reclassify a slow step after observing timing

resource_budget.memory_scope: entire owned worker process tree including Windows high-water memory

correctness.within_thread_between_modes: bitwise-identical ten-step dense parameter, gradient, Adam-state, training-loss, training-logit and unscored-logit trajectories, with exact RNG states before and after every step
correctness.within_setting_between_fresh_repeats: bitwise-identical ten-step trajectories and checkpoint fingerprints
correctness.across_threads: each non-four-thread setting compared with four threads in the same condition/mode/repeat at every step: all dense parameters, gradients, Adam state, training loss, training logits and unscored logits satisfy fixed allclose tolerances
correctness.rng_state: integer RNG state arrays before and after every step must match exactly in all comparisons, including across threads; never apply floating tolerances to RNG states
correctness.static_adjacency: exact invariant hashes across steps, both checkpoint modes, all retained slots and restored checkpoints
correctness.checkpoint_restoration: after the complete ten-step trajectory, restore retained snapshots and require identical complete-state and unscored-output behavior; do not perturb the training RNG stream
correctness.on_failure: retain and report; reject the setting; never relax tolerances or substitute seeds

qualification.candidate_unit: one fixed joint cpu-thread/checkpoint-mode setting across all four dataset-condition fixtures
qualification.geometric_speed_ratio: exp(mean(log(reference_slower_repeat_steady_median / candidate_slower_repeat_steady_median))) with four fixtures equally weighted
qualification.if_any_qualify: recommend adopting the verified execution setting within the measured scope, subject to later fixed all-eleven acceptance before formal use
qualification.if_none_qualify_or_scope_incomplete: recommend retaining the existing implementation and revising the proposed resource budget
qualification.selection_inputs: timing, memory, correctness and repeatability only; no accuracy-based choice

failure_and_resume.writes: exclusive append-only files in a new diagnostic directory; preserve every interrupted/failed attempt
failure_and_resume.no_post_observation_expansion: no added datasets, threads, modes, trials, steps or substitute implementations in this round
failure_and_resume.resume_note: no automatic diagnostic resume; formal stop/resume rules are a separate proposed budget item for user confirmation

launch_gates: same-SHA CI all three jobs successful
CI receipt saved and hashed into diagnostic manifest

must_specify: total cumulative runtime ceiling including attempts
formal_budget_proposal.extrapolation: do not replace the all-eleven v2 estimate by two-fixture speed ratios; retain v2 all-eleven budget evidence until a later complete resource acceptance

inference: one bounded post-hoc CPU execution diagnostic; no accuracy conclusion, independent confirmation, universal speedup or previously assumed bottleneck mechanism
